newsitem.title: UK: DHL, Lucent in 48 hr circuit delivery pact.
newsitem.headline: DHL, Lucent in 48 hr circuit delivery pact.

text.p: DHL Worldwide Express said it and Lucent Technologies' microtechnology group have signed an agreement under which DHL will ensure delivery of integrated circuits to customers anywhere in the world in 48 hours.

Lucent is the first supplier of semi-conductor components to make express transport its standard shipping method and the agreement forms part of a broader effort by Lucent aimed at reducing the average time from order to delivery to one week from up to eight weeks.

DHL service director Francis Rome said: "Distribution has become a powerful business tool to maintain a competitive edge. As a result, efficiency in this area plays a vital role in improving the bottom line."
